++bigger++ and --smaller--.
Nested: ++*big*++ and --_small_--.
-deleted- and +inserted+ still work.
---overlong--- stays literal, +++so+++ does too.
An unmatched --x opens nothing.
A trailing x-- closes nothing.
Spaced a -- b and intraword foo--bar and 2--4 stay em-dashed.
Inside @--code--@ the dashes stay literal.
